In a grid whose background is 5 and marker cells are 2, find pairs of 2s in the same row or same column. This supports a general geometry rule with colors varying: markers/background/fill were 6/8/3 in the demo.

Test (7x24) used marker 2, background 5, fill 3. The output from the final attempt was accepted. Recoloring is the union of horizontal and vertical bounded gaps; retain original marker cells and outside-background cells.
